items.name: lwjgl3
items.description: LWJGL is a Java library that enables cross-platform access to popular native APIs useful in the development of graphics (OpenGL, Vulkan, bgfx), audio (OpenAL, Opus), parallel computing (OpenCL, CUDA) and XR (OpenVR, LibOVR, OpenXR) applications.

items.name: YC-Killer
items.description: A library of enterprise-grade AI agents designed to democratize artificial intelligence and provide free, open-source alternatives to overvalued Y Combinator startups.
